info.title: AssemblyImpact Engineering Actions
info.description: Subset of the AssemblyImpact EngineeringReview OData V4 service (CAP) for SAP Build Actions and Joule. All data is synthetic (NovaMotion Manufacturing). Calculations are performed only by the backend runImpact action.

servers.description: Relative path; the base URL comes from the SAP BTP destination selected in SAP Build.

get.description: Lists the review cases visible to the calling user. The service restricts results to the user's plants (plant attribute). Use $filter (e.g. status eq 'IN_REVIEW'), $select and $expand=latestRun to include the latest impact figures.

get.description: Returns one immutable impact run. Use $expand=findings,materialLines,comparisonLines to include findings, stock shortages and BOM changes. The run ID is ReviewCases.latestRun_ID or the result of RunEngineeringImpact. Cross-plant IDs return 404.

parameters.description: key: ID
parameters.name: ID

post.description: Invokes the existing bound OData V4 action runImpact for one review case. Allowed for role ChangeAnalyst within the user's plants only (403 otherwise, 404 for other plants). Returns the new immutable impact run. Body: {"asOfDate": "YYYY-MM-DD"}.

get.description: Read-only. Optional named filters caseNumber (EC-000123), status (OPEN, IN_REVIEW, APPROVED, REJECTED) and assemblyCode. Returns at most 50 cases of the caller's plants with the latest impact figures. Synthetic demo data.
